entities.summary: Peter Kimani Ndung’u (b. 1966-11-11, Githunguri) was a entrepreneur or business leader of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Githunguri and Kenya. Known in the fields of kenya, religious figures, africa.
